product_family: AI music generation and creation platform (music generator, text-to-music, remix, sample packs, music distribution, API). Notable products: AI Music Generator, AI Text to Music, AI Song Remixer, AI Sample Generator, AI Stem Splitter, Music API, Music Maker JAM.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type I or Type II)
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of SOC 2 in terms of service, privacy policy, or publicly available security documentation

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of ISO 27001 in terms of service, privacy policy, or publicly available security documentation

certifications.name: ISO 27017 (Cloud security)
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of ISO 27017 in publicly available documentation

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance Posture
certifications.proof_quote: The information we have collected from you is stored exclusively on servers within the European Union. Sensitive information is encrypted during transfer using established security technology (SSL: Secure Socket Layer). Your personal information and payment details are protected by technical security systems and additional authorization procedures.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Not applicable. Loudly is a music creation platform, not a healthcare provider, and does not handle health information.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of PCI DSS in publicly available documentation. Company does process payments but does not claim PCI DSS compliance.

privacy.ai_training_note: Loudly explicitly trains on and improves AI models using user inputs and uploaded content. Terms state: 'you grant Loudly a limited, non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to process, transmit, and use your Instruction Inputs solely to provide, maintain, secure, and improve the Service.' This includes uploaded audio for remix, remastering, and stem separation features. No opt-out mechanism documented.

security.name: Data Encryption in Transit
security.value: SSL (Secure Socket Layer) used for data transfer protection

security.name: Data Residency
security.value: All data stored exclusively on servers within the European Union

security.name: Data Protection Measures
security.value: Reasonable technical and organizational measures designed to protect inputs and outputs. Personal information and payment details protected by technical security systems and additional authorization procedures.

security.name: Content Filtering
security.value: Uses audio fingerprinting or similar technologies to help detect potentially infringing uploads and support compliance checks

security.name: Retention Policy
security.value: Limited technical logs or records retained only to the extent necessary for security, abuse prevention, legal compliance, troubleshooting, or to operate the Service

security.name: Access Security
security.value: Additional authorization procedures for both data transfer and storage; users responsible for general use and security of their account

products.name: AI Music Generator

products.notes: Core product. Uses proprietary dataset with claimed consent, transparency, and copyright compliance. Generated outputs are royalty-free.

products.notes: Users grant Loudly license to use inputs for service improvement.

products.name: AI Song Remixer / Stem Splitter
products.notes: Explicitly states uploaded content may be used to train/improve AI models. No documented opt-out.

products.name: Music API
products.data_scope: Processes API inputs/outputs for music generation at scale
products.notes: Enterprise offering. Terms same as main platform. API documentation pages available but limited public security documentation.

products.name: Music Distribution

products.notes: Checks every track for copyright/platform compliance. Integrates with major platforms (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Amazon).

products.name: AI Sample Generator & AI Mastering
products.data_scope: Processes audio generation and enhancement inputs
products.notes: Subject to same data processing terms as core products.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium with paid tiers. Free tier includes limited generations. Paid subscriptions for higher usage and enterprise API pricing available.

flags: NO formal security certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001) despite being a growth-stage platform offering enterprise API services
MATERIAL: Platform trains on all user inputs and uploaded audio to improve AI models with no documented opt-out mechanism
Third-party AI model dependency: MANTA-1 generation model processed via Mureka (operated by SKYWORK AI PTE. LTD) — users subject to separate third-party terms
Privacy policy URL (https://www.loudly.com/privacy-policy) returns 404; privacy info scattered across /mmj-privacy and terms pages
No dedicated trust/security center; limited public security documentation for a company handling creative/audio content at scale
Ethical AI claims about dataset consent/transparency/copyright compliance stated on homepage but not independently verified or certified
Data protection described as 'reasonable' measures rather than specific industry standards; no security audit reports publicly available
